abstract: Significant advances in the management of disseminated carcinoma of the testis have had a tremendous influence on the management of all stages of disease, including both stage I and stage II. Because the disease is so uniformly curable in advanced forms, strategies have evolved for lower stages of disease to maximize curative potential with minimization of therapeutic intervention and potential long-term side effects. This review addresses issues of diagnosis and initial clinical staging of patients with stage I carcinoma of the testis. The usefulness of biological tumor markers and the accuracy, sensitivity, and specificity of radiographic imaging modalities are emphasized. The traditional treatment of stage I seminomas and nonseminomas includes the role of both radiation therapy and retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (RPLND). Treatment results and complications of each modality are also reviewed. The importance of orchiectomy followed by meticulous surveillance, as well as a critical analysis of prognostic features of subsequent locoregional or systemic relapse in patients with stage I testis cancer, focuses attention on changing concepts of this disease. The rationale underlying improved ability to stage patients meticulously and offer therapeutic intervention when necessary following orchiectomy, constitutes the focus of present and future clinical research. Such strategies are discussed in detail.
abstract_ja: 播種性精巣がんの治療における大きな進歩は、あらゆる病期の管理に影響を与えている。進行型では本疾患のほぼ全例が治癒可能であるため、低病期の症例では、治癒の可能性を最大化しつつ治療介入と長期的な副作用を最小限にとどめる戦略が発展してきた。本総説では、臨床病期I精巣がんの診断と初期の臨床病期分類を扱う。腫瘍マーカーの有用性と、画像診断法の正確性、感度、特異度を強調する。病期Iのセミノーマおよび非セミノーマの伝統的な治療には、放射線療法と後腹膜リンパ節郭清（RPLND）の双方が含まれる。各治療法の治療成績と合併症も概説する。精巣摘除術に続く綿密なフォローアップの重要性と、臨床病期I精巣がんにおける局所または全身性再発の予後因子の批判的分析は、この疾患に対する考え方の変化に焦点を当てている。術後に患者をより正確に病期分類し、必要に応じて治療介入を行う能力を高める根拠が、現在および将来の臨床研究の中心である。これらの戦略について詳細に論じる。
